from AlgorithmImports import *

class EquityOptionAlgorithm(QCAlgorithm):

    def initialize(self) -> None:
        self.set_start_date(2024, 9, 1)
        self.set_end_date(2024, 12, 31)
        self.set_cash(100000)
        # Seed the price of each asset with its last known price to avoid trading errors.
        self.settings.seed_initial_prices = True
        # Set the data normalization mode as raw for option strike-price comparability.
        self._spy = self.add_equity("SPY", data_normalization_mode=DataNormalizationMode.RAW)
        self.schedule.on(self.date_rules.every(DayOfWeek.MONDAY), self.time_rules.after_market_open(self._spy, 1), self._buildIronCondor)
        self.schedule.on(self.date_rules.every(DayOfWeek.FRIDAY), self.time_rules.before_market_close(self._spy, 5), self._closePositions)

    def _get_option_chain(self, expiry: int, delta: float) -> list[OptionContract]:
        chain = self.option_chain(self._spy)
        contracts = sorted([x for x in chain if x.expiry <= expiry and abs(x.strike - self._spy.price) < 10],
            key=lambda x: abs(x.strike - self._spy.price))
        if not contracts:
            return []
        atm_strike = contracts[0].strike
        return [x for x in chain if abs(x.strike - atm_strike) < delta]

    def _buildIronCondor(self) -> None:
        if not self.portfolio.invested:
            expiry = max([x.expiry for x in self.option_chain(self._spy)])
            atm_call = sorted([x for x in self.option_chain(self._spy) if x.expiry == expiry and x.right == OptionRight.CALL],
                key=lambda x: abs(x.strike - self._spy.price))[0]
            atm_put = sorted([x for x in self.option_chain(self._spy) if x.expiry == expiry and x.right == OptionRight.PUT],
                key=lambda x: abs(x.strike - self._spy.price))[0]
            otm_call = sorted([x for x in self.option_chain(self._spy) if x.expiry == expiry and x.right == OptionRight.CALL],
                key=lambda x: abs(x.strike - self._spy.price - 3))[0]
            otm_put = sorted([x for x in self.option_chain(self._spy) if x.expiry == expiry and x.right == OptionRight.PUT],
                key=lambda x: abs(x.strike - self._spy.price + 3))[0]
            iron_condor = OptionStrategies.iron_condor(self._spy, atm_call, atm_put, otm_call, otm_put)
            self.plot("Strategy", "Iron Condor", iron_condor)
            self.market_order(iron_condor)

    def _closePositions(self) -> None:
        for position in self.portfolio.positions.values():
            if position.type == OrderType.OPEN_INTEREST:
                self.liquidate(position.symbol)
